title: Japan Liquidity Enhancement Auction, remaining maturities 11–39 years — October's only other super-long supply, and the one that straddles both BoJ buckets
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 24,853 bytes) by the jgb-30y-auction-2026-10-08 initial research, whose table row reads 'Oct. 27, 2026 | Liquidity Enhancement Auction (remaining maturities of 11-39 years)'. No size is carried on the calendar and none is asserted here — MOF's own note on that page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms around 2026-10-20. A Liquidity Enhancement Auction reopens existing off-the-run issues rather than selling a new one, so it has no single issue number or coupon to cite in advance. Filed `estimate` on three counts: no size, no issue list until MOF's own 'Issues Re-opened' detail publishes, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: Discovered during the jgb-30y-auction-2026-10-08 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08) on MOF's own October calendar, which lists exactly three super-long supply events for the month — the 30-year on 10-08, the 20-year on 10-20 and this one — and no 40-year at all (the 40-year is bi-monthly; the jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29 ledger established that independently). It earns a slot on one term: its 11-39 year band is the only JGB supply event that straddles BOTH of the BoJ purchase buckets whose divergence the 30-year ledger measured. Across 16 monthly BoJ operation files (boj.or.jp/en/statistics/boj/fm/ope/m_release, 2024-01 -> 2026-08) the 'More than 25 years' bucket has been flat at ¥150bn a month for 32 consecutive months while 'More than 10 years and up to 25 years' was cut from ¥450bn to ¥200bn (-55%). Every other auction sells into one bucket; this one sells into both, so the relative demand MOF's own 'Issues Re-opened' detail reveals across the 11-39 year range is a direct read on whether the bucket split is what the market is pricing. It also lands three days before boj-decision-2026-10-30, already tracked. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low` for the same reasons the 30-year entry records: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, no house playbook is rates-keyed, and the JGB-auction-to-US-long-end channel does not survive controlling for the same-date JGB move. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
